name: Achish
overview: Achish, also known as Abimelech, was the king of Gath to whom David fled while escaping from Saul. The Scriptures reveal David's fear of Achish despite seeking refuge with him, as Achish's servants recognized David's renown and questioned his presence. To protect himself, David feigned madness before Achish and his servants, which led Achish to dismiss him as harmless. This account highlights David's reliance on God's protection amid danger and his wisdom in navigating hostile circumstances.
